rationale: This is a standard Hyperledger Fabric chaincode with Init and Invoke entrypoints. The code uses only deterministic operations: GetState, PutState, DelState with keys derived from transaction arguments. There are no time.Now() calls (C1), no goroutines (C2), no map iterations (C3), no rich queries like GetQueryResult (C4), and no mutable global state (C6). All state operations are based solely on transaction inputs and existing ledger state.
